title: Analytic umbral transmutations and Bessel moments
summary: We develop an analytic umbral approach to Bessel moments, using them as a concrete testbed justifying the passage from formal indicial umbral calculus to Mellin--Barnes umbral transmutation theory. [...] While the formal procedure reproduces the correct results in suitable convergence chambers, it may lead to non-admissible hypergeometric expansions at physically relevant parameter values. The cubic moment provides the basic example [...] We show that this obstruction is removed by replacing the purely formal expansion with an analytic umbral transmutation.
